name: A pattern without a timeout gets one
A pattern with its own timeout is used as it is
The bounded copy is built once, not per scope
old: : Bounded.GetValue(pattern, static p => new Regex(p.ToString(), p.Options, PatternTimeout));
new: : new Regex(pattern.ToString(), pattern.Options, PatternTimeout) ?? Bounded.GetValue(pattern, static p => p);

name: The copy keeps the pattern's options
